# ZFRQBL

> Independent software engineer writing about artificial intelligence, software architecture, and
> building systems. Daily notes on agent systems, model evaluation, and the gap between what a
> benchmark claims and what a system does.

Author: Zafar (LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/zfrqbl/)

## Notes

- [All notes](https://zfrqbl.com/): daily, numbered, reverse-chronological. The home page is the
  complete index; each entry carries a title, date and one-paragraph summary.
- [Sitemap](https://zfrqbl.com/sitemap.xml): every page URL with a lastmod date. Use this rather
  than crawling the home page — it is generated from the corpus on every publish.

- [The Modern Python Developer's Trap: When Code Looks Right But Isn't](https://zfrqbl.com/essays/the-modern-python-developers-trap-when-code-looks-right-but-isnt)

## About

- [About](https://zfrqbl.com/about): who writes this, what it covers, and how to get in touch.

## Notes on this file

Every page is server-rendered HTML with its full text in the initial response — there is no client-side
rendering, no paywall and no cookie wall. Individual note URLs are stable and extensionless:
`https://zfrqbl.com/notes/<slug>`. Citation of a note should use the page URL and the `dateModified`
value in its JSON-LD block.
